map.YAML 为什么容易出错，如何用 ToolBox 校验语法并和 JSON 互转，: Why YAML errors easily, how to validate syntax and interconvert with JSON using ToolBox, with notes on indentation and anchors.
map.YAML 是 JSON 的超集，用缩进表达层级、更易读，常用于配置文件（如 CI: YAML is a superset of JSON, using indentation for hierarchy and being more readable, common in config files (CI, K8s). It can still be converted to JSON, so 'validate as JSON first' is a common troubleshooting approach.
map.YAML 对空格缩进极其敏感，Tab 与空格混用会直接报错。统一用 2 个空格，: YAML is extremely sensitive to space indentation; mixing Tab and spaces errors outright. Use 2 spaces uniformly and align siblings.
map.粘贴 YAML 点击校验，错误会定位到行；一键转为 JSON 后可直接用 JSO: Paste YAML and click validate; errors locate to the line; one-click convert to JSON to continue with the JSON toolchain.
map.YAML 的 & 锚点和 * 别名是什么？: What are YAML's & anchors and * aliases?
map.它们是 YAML 的复用机制：&anchor 定义、*alias 引用，能减少重: They are YAML's reuse mechanism: &anchor defines, *alias references, reducing repetition; converting to JSON expands them to actual values.
map.会。YAML 把 yes/no/on/off 也当布尔，敏感场景下建议加引号写成: Yes. YAML also treats yes/no/on/off as booleans; in sensitive cases quote them as "yes" to avoid ambiguity.
map.Tab 真的不能用吗？: Can Tab really not be used?
map.标准 YAML 不允许 Tab 缩进，很多解析器会直接报错；务必用空格。: Standard YAML forbids Tab indentation; many parsers error outright—always use spaces.
